description: Authenticated mobile-first app shell, bottom navigation, reusable finance/shared/layout presentational components, and the Home dashboard page STRUCTURE (static placeholder data, no data layer). Depends on FEAT-001 (design tokens: income/expense/account colors, radii, shadow-soft, viewport/safe-area) and is cleaner after FEAT-002 (which removes /protected and repoints '/'). Mobile-first, iPhone safe-area aware, phone-width and centered on desktop.
steps: Create components/finance/amount-text.tsx — AmountText presentational component (Server-safe, no 'use client'): props { value: number; tone?: 'default'|'income'|'expense'; size?: 'sm'|'md'|'lg'|'xl'; currency?: string; className?: string }. Render with Intl.NumberFormat (default currency 'USD' as placeholder — note in a comment it is a placeholder), always apply tabular-nums and tracking-tight; tone maps default->text-foreground, income->text-income, expense->text-expense; size scales font (xl is the big balance, e.g. text-4xl font-bold). Use cn from @/lib/utils.

Create components/finance/account-card.tsx — AccountCard (Server-safe): props { name: string; balance: number; accent: 'blue'|'violet'|'emerald'|'amber'|'rose'|'slate'; icon?: LucideIcon; className?: string }. A rounded-2xl colorful card using the account-accent tokens (e.g. bg-account-blue text-account-blue-foreground) — this is the ONLY place accent colors are used. Compact lucide icon, account name, and balance via AmountText (inherit the card's foreground color). Use cn.

Create components/finance/balance-card.tsx — BalanceCard (Server-safe): neutral large total-balance block, bg-card, rounded-2xl, border, shadow-soft, generous padding; a small muted label (e.g. 'Total balance') and the amount via <AmountText size='xl' />. Optional subtitle/delta slot. Use cn.

Create components/shared/section-header.tsx — SectionHeader (Server-safe): props { title: string; action?: React.ReactNode; className? }. Title in font-semibold with optional right-aligned action. Neutral.

Create components/shared/empty-state.tsx — EmptyState (Server-safe): props { icon?: LucideIcon; title: string; description?: string; className? }. Centered neutral placeholder with compact muted icon, title, and optional description.

Create components/layout/bottom-nav.tsx — BottomNav client component ('use client'). Fixed bottom bar centered to max-w-md (fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 with an inner mx-auto max-w-md), bg-background with a subtle top border, bottom padding pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]. Items array: Home '/dashboard' (Home), Transactions '/transactions' (Receipt or ArrowLeftRight), Accounts '/accounts' (Wallet), Budget '/budget' (PieChart or ChartPie), Settings '/settings' (Settings) using lucide-react. Use usePathname() from next/navigation; active item (pathname === href or startsWith) uses text-foreground, inactive text-muted-foreground. Compact icon (size ~20) stacked over a small label. Links to not-yet-built routes are acceptable.

Create components/layout/page-container.tsx — PageContainer (Server-safe): wrapper applying horizontal padding (px-4), vertical spacing, and bottom padding so content clears the fixed BottomNav. Accepts className + children.

Create components/layout/app-header.tsx — AppHeader (Server-safe): props { title: string; subtitle?: string; action?: React.ReactNode }. Top-of-page header with top safe-area padding pt-[env(safe-area-inset-top)], title in bold, optional subtitle muted, optional action slot. Subtle/no heavy borders.

Create app/(app)/layout.tsx — authenticated shell (Server Component). Define an async guard component that calls `const supabase = await createClient(); const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims(); if (!data?.claims) redirect('/auth/login');` and render children — this mirrors app/protected/page.tsx. Because next.config.ts has cacheComponents:true, the dynamic auth call MUST run inside a <Suspense> boundary (wrap the guard/children in <Suspense>), or the PPR build step fails. Shell markup: a root div with min-h-dvh, mx-auto max-w-md, w-full, relative; a main region with top safe-area padding (pt-[env(safe-area-inset-top)]) and bottom padding to clear the nav; render children (gated by the auth guard) then <BottomNav />. Import BottomNav from @/components/layout/bottom-nav and createClient from @/lib/supabase/server.

Create app/(app)/dashboard/page.tsx — Home dashboard STRUCTURE (Server Component, static placeholder data only, no data fetching). Compose: optional <AppHeader title='Home' /> (or an inline greeting), a prominent <BalanceCard> showing a sample total (e.g. 12345.67), a horizontal row/grid (grid-cols-2 or horizontal scroll) of 3-4 <AccountCard>s each with a distinct accent ('blue','emerald','violet','amber') and sample names/balances (e.g. Checking, Savings, Credit, Cash), then a <SectionHeader title='Recent activity' /> followed by either an <EmptyState> or 3-4 static placeholder transaction rows (neutral rows: label, date, AmountText with income/expense tone). Wrap everything in <PageContainer>. Clean, uncluttered, generous whitespace. No 'use client' here.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` exits 0 and the Route table lists /dashboard.

app/(app)/layout.tsx guards access via supabase.auth.getClaims() and redirects to /auth/login when unauthenticated, with the dynamic auth call inside a <Suspense> boundary (build does not fail under cacheComponents).
BottomNav is a client component using usePathname for active-route highlighting, links to /dashboard /transactions /accounts /budget /settings, and has safe-area bottom padding.

The dashboard renders a large bold total balance (tabular-nums), 3-4 colorful AccountCards (the only accent-colored surfaces), and a neutral Recent activity section; the shell is max-w-md centered on desktop and uses env(safe-area-inset-*) insets.
No Supabase auth/lib/proxy or app/auth/* files were modified.
verification: Run `npm run build`; confirm exit 0 and that /dashboard appears in the Route table and the build does not error on cacheComponents/PPR.
Run `npm run lint`; confirm no errors.
Read app/(app)/layout.tsx to confirm the Suspense-wrapped getClaims guard and the max-w-md/safe-area shell.
findings:
DONE. Build exit 0; /dashboard appears in Route table as '◐' (Partial Prerender) — the Suspense-wrapped getClaims auth guard streams the dynamic auth check, so PPR/cacheComponents does NOT error. Lint of all new files (`npx eslint` on app/(app)/**, components/{finance,shared,layout}/**) exits 0. (A bare `npm run lint` still reports ~22k pre-existing errors from the gitignored .next/ dir + the tailwind.config.ts require() rule — none from this feature; see FEAT-001/002 findings.)

CREATED:
- components/finance/amount-text.tsx — AmountText (Server-safe). Props {value, tone?: default|income|expense, size?: sm|md|lg|xl, currency?='USD' (placeholder, commented), className?}. Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', currency). Always tabular-nums tracking-tight. tone -> text-foreground/text-income/text-expense. size: sm=text-sm, md=text-base, lg=text-2xl, xl=text-4xl font-bold.
- components/finance/account-card.tsx — AccountCard (Server-safe). rounded-2xl, accent prop (blue|violet|emerald|amber|rose|slate) -> bg-account-<accent> text-account-<accent>-foreground. THE ONLY accent-colored surface. Compact lucide icon (size-5), name, AmountText size='lg' with className='text-current' to inherit card foreground.
- components/finance/balance-card.tsx — BalanceCard (Server-safe). Neutral bg-card rounded-2xl border shadow-soft p-6. label (default 'Total balance') + AmountText size='xl' + optional subtitle slot.
- components/shared/section-header.tsx — SectionHeader {title, action?, className?}. h2 font-semibold + optional right action.
- components/shared/empty-state.tsx — EmptyState {icon?, title, description?, className?}. Centered muted placeholder.
- components/layout/bottom-nav.tsx — 'use client' BottomNav. fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 z-40 border-t bg-background, inner mx-auto max-w-md, pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]. Items: /dashboard(Home), /transactions(ArrowLeftRight), /accounts(Wallet), /budget(PieChart), /settings(Settings). usePathname active = exact or startsWith(href+'/') -> text-foreground else text-muted-foreground. Icon size-5 over text-xs label. Exported as named `BottomNav`.
- components/layout/page-container.tsx — PageContainer {children, className?}. px-4, gap-6, pb-[calc(5rem+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] to clear the fixed nav.
- components/layout/app-header.tsx — AppHeader {title, subtitle?, action?, className?}. pt-[env(safe-area-inset-top)], title text-2xl font-bold, muted subtitle, optional action.
- app/(app)/layout.tsx — Server Component shell. Async AuthGuard calls createClient()+getClaims(), redirect('/auth/login') if no claims; rendered inside <Suspense> (required under cacheComponents). Root div: relative mx-auto max-w-md min-h-dvh flex-col; <main> pt-[env(safe-area-inset-top)] flex-1; <BottomNav/> below.
- app/(app)/dashboard/page.tsx — Server Component, STATIC placeholder data (no fetching). AppHeader title='Home', BalanceCard 12345.67, 2-col grid of 4 AccountCards (Checking/blue, Savings/emerald, Credit/violet, Cash/amber), SectionHeader 'Recent activity' + 4 static rows (label/date + AmountText income/expense). EmptyState wired for the empty case. Wrapped in PageContainer.

INTEGRATION NOTES for next step: All layout/finance/shared components use NAMED exports (import { BottomNav } from '@/components/layout/bottom-nav', etc.). Account accent colors live ONLY in AccountCard. Future pages (/transactions, /accounts, /budget, /settings) should live under app/(app)/ to inherit the shell + nav; their nav links already exist. AppHeader+PageContainer are the standard page scaffold. NOTE: FEAT-002 left components/auth-button.tsx orphaned/harmless; FEAT-001 icon PNGs still absent (see public/icons/README.md).
